rows: Check any noise or vibration in pump

 to the pump

sections.text:
After isolated 
the pump mechanically and electrically

rows:
Check the coupling pins and changed the inserts of carrying 
 pins (polyamide) if needed.

Change the packing if there is more leakage and did not 
 prevent by tighten the gland bolts.

Prevent the leakage of lubricating oil in bearing housing of 
 the pump.

Add lubricating oil to pump if oil level less than 2/3 oil 
 side glass.

Retighten the bolts connected pump, and motor with 
 foundation.
Check the alignment between pump and motor

sections.text:
Inspection every 6 month
Before isolated the pump mechanically and electrically

rows: Check any noise or vibration in pump

Check the amount of leakage from stuffing box and minimized 
 it by retighten the gland bolts and keep some drops for cooling.
Check any leakage from the pipes connections to the pump.

Check leakage of lubricating oil in bearing house of the 
 pump
Check the pressure in the pumps delivery.

Check the temperature of all bearing house , it must be less 
 than 70 C

sections.text:
After isolated 
the pump mechanically and electrically

rows:
Check the impeller and casing from mechanical wear and measure the 
 clearances by dismantle the pump

Change the packing if leakage is heavy and 
 didnt prevented by tighten the gland bolts

Prevent the leakage of lubricating oil 
 from bearing house of the pump
Change the lubricating oil in pump

Check the couplings pins and changed the 
 inserts of carrying pins (Polyamide) if needed

Retighten all bolts connected pump and motor 
 with foundation.
Check the alignment between pump and motor.

Introduction
This document lists the equipment 
 inspection steps I1 of single stage horizontal centrifugal pump 
 which must be performed every 2 and 6 months as indicated by M2, M6 in 
 the title block.
The first draft initiated by 
eng. Hesham M. Hassan, reviewed by director eng. Saad Mostafa, and revised by 
quality control eng. Samir Abdel Gelil at EDEPCo., accepted by general director eng. Ali Al-Lithy
and approved by eng. Mostafa Alam: Head Sector of Talkha Steam
